help.trigger: How do I get my keys?

woocommerce.title: WooCommerce API keys
woocommerce.step1: In the WordPress dashboard, go to WooCommerce → Settings → Advanced → REST API.
woocommerce.step2: Click "Add key" and give it a description (e.g. Evo CRM).
woocommerce.step3: Set Permissions to "Read" and generate the key.
woocommerce.step4: Copy the Consumer key (ck_...) and Consumer secret (cs_...) — the secret is shown only once.

shopify.title: Shopify Admin API token
shopify.step1: In Shopify admin, go to Settings → Apps and sales channels → Develop apps.
shopify.step2: Create an app and, under Admin API configuration, grant the read_products scope.
shopify.step3: Install the app on the store.
shopify.step4: Copy the Admin API access token (shpat_...) and use the .myshopify.com domain.
